problem.title: Monthly Churn Rate by Signup Cohort
problem.prompt: Your subscription box service tracks renewals and cancellations in the `subscriptions` table. Each row records a subscription's `signup_date` (when they first subscribed) and `cancelled_date` (NULL if still active, otherwise the cancellation date). Calculate the churn rate for each monthly signup cohort. A cohort is defined by the month in which users signed up (use `DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)` to bucket them). The churn rate is the percentage of subscriptions in that cohort that have been cancelled (i.e., `cancelled_date IS NOT NULL`). Only include cohorts where at least 2 subscriptions signed up in that month. Return columns `cohort_month` (DATE, the first day of the signup month), `total_signups` (count of all subscriptions in that cohort), `cancelled_count` (count of cancelled subscriptions), and `churn_rate` (percentage, rounded to 2 decimal places, e.g., 33.33 for 33.33%). Order by `cohort_month` ascending.

composite_moves: DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) to bucket into cohorts
SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) for cancelled_count
Calculate churn_rate as (cancelled_count * 100.0 / total_signups) rounded to 2 decimals

hints: Use DATE_TRUNC to group subscriptions by the month they signed up.
Count total subscriptions per cohort and count how many have a non-NULL cancelled_date, then filter cohorts with at least 2 signups using HAVING.
The churn rate is (cancelled_count * 100.0 / total_signups); use ROUND(..., 2) and cast the result to match the expected string format.
problem.answer_key: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::DATE AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS total_signups, SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2)::TEXT AS churn_rate FROM subscriptions GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY cohort_month ASC;

_meta.scenario: a D2C subscription box service tracking renewal and churn

user_solution:
/*
1. create cohort_month
2. group by
total_signups = COUNT(subscription_id)
cancelled_count = SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)
churn_rate = SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(subscription_id)

*/

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::date AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(subscription_id) AS total_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)::int AS cancelled_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN cancelled_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)*100, 0),2) AS churn_rate
FROM subscriptions
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date)::date
HAVING COUNT(subscription_id) >= 2
ORDER BY cohort_month;
